The '''battle of the Dachat system''' was a battle fought during the [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] near the Alsakan-controlled [[Dachat system/Legends|Dachat system]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
